description.en: Starts an animated camera move: interpolates the camera from its current position/reference to a target position and reference over a number of frames, using a given movement type/easing.
Duration of the move, in frames.
Always returns null — the native never pushes a meaningful Squirrel value, whether the call succeeds or is rejected (e.g. for too few arguments).

example.code:
// Animate the camera to a new position/reference over several frames
CMND_SET_MOVE_INFO_CAMERA(_hcam, move.pos, move.ref, _mv_frame, _mv_type);
